name: Adaptive Cache Action (Deprecated)
description: Automatically chooses GitHub Actions cache for public repos, S3 for private/internal repos

path.description: A list of files, directories, and wildcard patterns to cache and restore

key.description: An explicit key for restoring and saving the cache

restore-keys.description: An ordered list of prefix-matched keys to use for restoring stale cache if no cache hit occurred for key

upload-chunk-size.description: The chunk size used to split up large files during upload, in bytes

enableCrossOsArchive.description: When enabled, allows to save or restore caches that can be restored or saved respectively on other platforms

fail-on-cache-miss.description: Fail the workflow if cache entry is not found

lookup-only.description: Check if a cache entry exists for the given input(s) (key, restore-keys) without downloading the cache
